cases.reason: Explicit decisions now work over HTTP (E3-DECISION-WORKFLOW); automatic context/proposal confirmation is still absent.
No public entry creates a review Work/Ticket/Assignment or publishes ReviewEvidence; the independent pilot preflight is BLOCKED on pricing.
No public entry creates a question with a real decisionDeadline/expiresAt in this checkout; waiting-age and unknown-wait ordering are verified instead.
No public entry deletes/changes the source message or expires the project grant; transaction-failure injection is not exposed. These remain NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: context preview now exists, but automatic proposal confirmation and grant/revocation invalidation do not. Required inputs: proposal id/revision, source message and digest, current grant/scope/profile/contract, decision to confirm, plus context preview with project/conversation/work binding, window and invalidity. Planned negatives: unconfirmed means no execution; a failed original command leaves no half-confirmed state; an unknown response reuses the same command id; source/actor/grant/scope/profile/version drift is refused; revoke invalidates later context; cross-project isolation and reopen.

NOT_TESTED: E3-CONTEXT-PREVIEW verifies clamped budgets, omissions and basic refusals, but no public entry binds an expired grant or purpose mismatch to the read path. Required: expired grant, purpose mismatch, caller budget above the grant and negative/NaN budget must be refused before any provider read, with the effective window and truncation reported. The C composer probe shows these still fail at the library boundary, so a product pass cannot be claimed.

stages.title: First milestone: current package UI and readiness
notes: Real readiness HTTP in normal/readonly/fixture with schema, auth, query and revision facts; real trial workbench navigation; absent surfaces stay precise NOT_REACHED.

cases.reason: Distribution source paths absent from this checkout: none. A frozen tar.gz is published outside Git and independently accepted by E4-INSTALL-*; source-level installation and migration remain Agent D owned and are not claimed by this case.

Read-only inspect/prepare are verified (plan authorization=not_granted, commitAvailable=false, no writes, stale/foreign/commit refused). The commit path, expiry/drift/replay/rollback of a real grant, and activation of only new work are not implemented and stay NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: current main product path uses ProductExecution with fixture/Codex profiles, but B's new production control candidate is not consumed by main and native execution is outside this wave. Required: actual product begin command -> Work/Ticket/effect/fact_receipts/dispatch_receipts/answers/answer_deliveries/user_questions/runtime rows, real transport/epoch counts, independent process SIGKILL, unknown no resend, and stop/answer through the existing queue. A fixture or receipt-only row is not production recovery.

stages.title: Scope and source diagnostics guards
notes: Plain default shape and opt-in plain/narrow HTTP 200 remain required with bounded reasons/counts; negatives start from an independent legal positive.

cases.reason: No executed native stop/question/recovery evidence is available in this checkout.

NOT_TESTED: main has published RecoveryTargetConfiguration/preparation/material/inventory schemas and a configuration binder, but no commit/activate HTTP or composed target startup. Required inputs: source-committed activation fact, A read-only inventory, D materializer readback, main activation pointer switch, and crash replay semantics. Planned negatives: interruption before source commit, after source commit but before target preparation, during target preparation, and at pointer switch must never dispatch old queues, never grant authority from an old ended/PID/missing writer, and never duplicate authorization on response loss or restart; a backup/re-restore must not inherit executable authority. A schema or read-only prepare is not activation.

stages.title: Stale responses, auth and instance reuse
notes: Same-file REUSED keeps PID/processStart/digest; different/missing selection, root and port are refused without changing the live instance.

cases.reason: NOT_REACHED: the scope-review marker exists in this package and its backend ?scopeReview=1 plain/narrow responses are measured, but the independent browser expansion of a restored message scope has not been recorded. Navigation and the trial workbench are separately browser-verified in E3-TRIAL-WORKBENCH-UI.

stages.title: A/C target and fingerprint mapping
notes: Original target, consumer entry and capability are read from the package bytes; opaque echoes and synthetic provenance cannot satisfy the required evidence.

stages.title: Second milestone: drift negatives and recovery consumers
notes: Complete drift/source/mapping negatives and recovered-read consumers are reported with exact refusal reasons.

stages.title: Two formats in one data chain
notes: A source create/verify in default v1 and explicit v2 is consumed by the package into two fresh roots; the A/C chain remains separately NOT_REACHED when its consumer is absent.

stages.title: Ordinary cold install, no executor and multi-state
notes: Cold first-run/personal start, fixture and multi-state are bounded probe-owned resources; no real profile fallback and no user instance is touched.

stages.title: Upgrade, rollback and new data protection
notes: A826->ce64 and 16->18 upgrades keep exit/status/pointer/operation/data; new data is not rolled back to pass rollback.

stages.title: Third milestone: complete same-package required layers
notes: UI/readiness, restored review, workflow formats and ordinary install/upgrade keep separate required conclusions; native/private/target/value stay not reached.

stages.title: Bounded availability and reopen
notes: Bounded readonly concurrency, reopen and stop paths are measured with provider/queue unchanged; no long soak is claimed.

stages.title: G/H observation scope
notes: G/H summaries remain inputs: wrong-scope metrics, refused-then-executed tools and unverified checkers do not become acceptance authority.

stages.title: Support material and current trial promise
notes: Support/private material stays 0600 and non-overwriting; current guidance matches the real selector/CLI/readiness; docs do not re-freeze packages.

stages.title: Fourth milestone: credible current product conclusion
notes: wave26-status, four checkpoints, real commands/exit/tuples/consumers/times and remaining gates; goal stays incomplete where required layers are NOT_REACHED.
Controlled fixture, SDK mock, readonly and installed evidence never substitute for actual-native execution.
A NOT_TESTED or BLOCKED gap is honest only when the release claim excludes that capability; there is no allow-gap switch.

Planned negatives: interruption before source commit, after source commit but before target preparation, during target preparation, and at pointer switch must never dispatch old queues, never grant authority from an old ended/PID/missing writer, and never duplicate authorization on response loss or restart; a backup/re-restore must not inherit executable authority.
